summary: Expose related retained request history through client-v0 and MCP

replay.detail: Read adapters reuse the existing retained request-history projection without changing replay or writers.

schema.detail: Add GET /v1/client/threads/{id}/request-history with optional opaque cursor and limit, returning RequestHistoryPage. Add the MCP-only assistant thread-request-history projection and fractal_thread_request_history tool. Thread detail and timeline responses are unchanged.

rules.detail: Person-client history uses the existing thread read authorization. Assistant history requires assistant/mcp with the existing read.assistant.conversation scope, current agent/session selection and thread ownership. Every page reauthorizes sources. History relations grant no write or answer authority.

compatibility.detail: Generated clients expose the additive history read and request-history DTOs. Cursors pass through unchanged. Person-client limits follow the store's existing 1..50 clamping convention; assistant and MCP limits are bounded to 1..50.

manual.detail: No new scope or grant kind; existing MCP conversation grants apply.
